design_case: Register source S generation E1 with target T, yielding R1. Retire/reset S; R1 stays at T and S retains the exact retired-intent witness.
Create a legitimate fresh S generation E2 and register it with T as R2 before beginning erasure. Both registrations are inside the same target high-water; current E2 behavior/payload must be erased.

The ascending page first cleans R1. S recognizes E1 as already retired and stores identityErasure:J with witness digest(R1), without touching E2; T acknowledges R1 and the controller checkpoints progress.

The next source cleanup sends R2 under J. S reads the R1 receipt and throws because digest(R2) differs, before checking E2's exact intent/authority. Every retry repeats that refusal. R2's current behavior/transfer remains and the job cannot finish.
